points.K8: 接触电气设备的人都要培训

shots.scene: 欣欣站在配电箱旁，手里拿着空白记录板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an electrical panel holding a blank clipboard and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电气危害的风险评估。
overlay: 用电风险，先评估再动手

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室前，阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: In a training room, the safety administrator stands at the front while the young male student raises his hand.
shots.narration: 培训课上，阿杰问了个常见问题：

shots.scene: 阿杰头顶出现闪电和问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A lightning bolt icon and a question mark float above the young male student's head.
shots.narration: 电气危害的风险，到底怎么评估？

shots.section_title: 电气风险可以按步骤评估
shots.scene: 王老师指着空白屏幕讲解，学员听讲
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank screen while students listen.
shots.narration: 答案是：按程序做一次全面评估。
overlay: 电气风险可以按步骤评估

shots.section_title: 电气风险可以按步骤评估
shots.scene: 小研在仪器旁向两名学员讲解，放大镜扫过电线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains beside an instrument to two students as a magnifying glass icon scans its power cord.
shots.narration: 审查系统或作业的潜在危害，估计可预见风险。

shots.scene: 阶梯第一级：放大镜找到闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Step one on a staircase diagram: a magnifying glass finding a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一，识别作业、系统或工艺的电气危害。

shots.scene: 阶梯第二级：空白任务卡和螺丝刀
shots.prompt_en: Step two on the staircase: a blank task card with a screwdriver icon. No people.
shots.narration: 二，明确要进行的是哪项电气工作。

shots.scene: 阶梯第三级：从轻到重的伤害刻度
shots.prompt_en: Step three on the staircase: a severity scale from a small bandage to a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 三，评估可能造成的伤害有多严重。

shots.scene: 阶梯第四级：断线、老化插头图标指向触电
shots.prompt_en: Step four on the staircase: icons of a broken wire and a worn plug pointing to a shock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 四，找出会导致接触危害的失效及后果。

shots.scene: 阶梯第五级：红色风险表加上盾牌后变绿
shots.prompt_en: Step five on the staircase: a risk gauge in the red zone turns green after a shield icon is added. No people.
shots.narration: 五，风险不可接受，就追加纠正措施。

shots.section_title: 管理措施比单靠防护有效
shots.scene: 倒三角控制层级图，管理控制一层亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle of five control levels with the administrative controls level glowing above the protective equipment level. No people.
shots.narration: 按控制层级，管理控制比个人防护更有效。
overlay: 管理措施比单靠防护有效

shots.section_title: 管理措施比单靠防护有效
shots.scene: 管理控制一层分出培训、标识、规程三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The administrative controls level splits into three icons: a classroom, a warning sign and a procedure card. No people.
shots.narration: 它是管控电气危害的关键。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰穿防护服，拿着记录板站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student in protective coats stand at a lab bench holding blank clipboards.
shots.narration: 其一是培训：人人懂危害、会安全作业。

shots.scene: 铁链围住的电气设备，墙上挂着警示牌
shots.prompt_en: Electrical equipment fenced off with a chain, an electrical hazard warning sign and an authorized-personnel-only sign on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 其二是标识：提醒危害，提示安全做法。

shots.scene: 空白的分步操作规程卡贴在配电箱旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank step-by-step procedure card posted beside an electrical panel. No people.
shots.narration: 其三最重要：标准操作规程。

shots.scene: 老李对照规程卡一步步操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer follows the blank procedure card step by step at the panel.
shots.narration: 规定标准步骤，保证安全又一致。

shots.section_title: 规定要执行，不能放一边
shots.scene: 一本空白法规册，封面是星条旗图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation booklet with a stars-and-stripes flag icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 美国职业安全卫生法规有电气专章，
overlay: 规定要执行，不能放一边

shots.section_title: 规定要执行，不能放一边
shots.scene: 法规册被丢在角落积灰，几栋厂房图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: The blank regulation booklet lying dusty in a corner beside several facility building icons with question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 但不少单位没遵守，甚至忽视它。

shots.section_title: 接触电气设备的人都要培训
shots.scene: 三名戴安全帽、穿反光背心的人看记录板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, the older man and the young male student in hard hats and reflective vests look at a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 安装、维护、维修或在附近工作的人，
overlay: 接触电气设备的人都要培训

shots.section_title: 接触电气设备的人都要培训
shots.scene: 四个工作图标都连到空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: Icons for installing, maintaining, repairing and working nearby, each linked to a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 都必须接受相关危害培训。

shots.section_title: 电气测试不戴金属饰物
shots.scene: 两人用螺丝刀在墙上插座处操作，一人戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in safety glasses and the young male student without glasses work at a wall outlet with screwdrivers.
shots.narration: 法规明令禁止过去的一些随意做法，
overlay: 电气测试不戴金属饰物

shots.section_title: 电气测试不戴金属饰物
shots.scene: 手腕上金色手链的特写，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a gold bracelet on a wrist, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 比如电气测试时戴导电饰物。

shots.section_title: 规范管设计，也管干活的人
shots.scene: 戴安全帽的老李仰头查看配电柜接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat looks up into an open electrical cabinet at the wiring.
shots.narration: 这些法规侧重电气系统的设计安全，
overlay: 规范管设计，也管干活的人

shots.section_title: 规范管设计，也管干活的人
shots.scene: 两名穿反光服的人在配电柜前看平板
shots.prompt_en: Two people in reflective jackets, the older man and the facility engineer, look at a tablet in front of an electrical cabinet.
shots.narration: 适用于装修电路设备和附近工作的人。

shots.scene: 空白标准书封面是火焰图标，标题电气安全要求
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard book with a flame icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 美国消防协会的电气安全标准，

shots.scene: 标准书箭头推向法规册，老李在配电柜前记录
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from the standard book into the regulation booklet, while the facility engineer takes notes at a cabinet.
shots.narration: 早被广泛采用，影响了新的法规要求。

shots.section_title: 测试按标准，电弧要评估
shots.scene: 小研走过配电室长廊
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks down a long corridor lined with electrical cabinets.
shots.narration: 电气电子工程师学会也有专业标准，
overlay: 测试按标准，电弧要评估

shots.section_title: 测试按标准，电弧要评估
shots.scene: 老李在桥架下接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer connects wiring beneath a cable tray.
shots.narration: 指导电气系统的设计、运行和维护。

shots.section_title: 测试按标准，电弧要评估
shots.scene: 万用表在配电箱内测量，电弧图标旁有计算器
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter measuring inside an electrical box, with an arc flash icon next to a calculator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它提供了电弧危害的计算方法。

shots.section_title: 测试按标准，电弧要评估
shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽护目镜手持万用表，配电箱上有触电警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat and safety glasses holds a multimeter at a panel with an electrical shock warning sign.
shots.narration: 做电气测试的人，应按这些标准来测。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a five-step staircase icon.
shots.narration: 五步评估：识别、明确、评估、找因、追加。

shots.scene: 培训、标识、规程三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a classroom, a warning sign and a procedure card. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制靠培训、标识和规程。

shots.scene: 法规册、标准书、手链打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a regulation booklet, a standard book and a crossed-out bracelet. No people.
shots.narration: 守法规、按标准，测试不戴饰物。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白记录板挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank clipboard and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 先评估再动手，平安用电，下次见！
